text_blocks.snippet: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS) is typically asymptomatic. However, in rare cases, some individuals may experience mild symptoms, which can include:
Fatigue, Bone pain, Nerve damage (numbness, tingling), Skin rashes, Dizziness, Weakness, and Blurred vision.

text_blocks.snippet: It's important to note that these symptoms are not specific to MGUS and can be caused by other underlying conditions. If you experience any of these symptoms, it's essential to consult a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment.
